strings.name: Cheng Wei
strings.summary: After working at Alibaba and Alipay, Cheng founded DiDi Dache in 2012 and helped expand taxi booking into a broader digital-mobility platform. The Kuaidi merger and Uber China acquisition expanded its reach, while passenger safety, data governance and IPO disclosures drew scrutiny. He apologized after passenger killings and received a personal administrative fine in the 2022 data case; US investor litigation was later settled.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded DiDi and advanced ride-hailing platforms and digital mobility, influencing urban transport and platform-governance issues.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Bachelor’s in administration management, Beijing University of Chemical Technology (2004).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Digital-mobility platform
strings.highlights.h1.text: Founded DiDi Dache and helped expand the platform through Kuaidi and Uber China transactions.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Safety and governance responsibilities
strings.highlights.h2.text: Passenger safety and data penalties highlight platform responsibilities; administrative sanctions, allegations and settlement are distinct.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Investor settlement approved
strings.timeline.t1.text: A US court approved DiDi’s $740 million IPO investor settlement; defendants denied wrongdoing, and this was not a criminal conviction.
strings.timeline.t2.title: New-user registration resumes
strings.timeline.t2.text: Regulators allowed DiDi to resume registering new users in China.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Administrative data penalties
strings.timeline.t3.text: Authorities fined DiDi RMB 8.026 billion and separately fined Cheng and Jean Liu RMB 1 million each.
strings.timeline.t4.title: New York listing
strings.timeline.t4.text: DiDi listed in New York, faced a cybersecurity review and delisted the following year.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Apologizes after passenger killings
strings.timeline.t5.text: Cheng and Jean Liu apologized and pledged to prioritize safety over growth.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Acquires Uber China
strings.timeline.t6.text: DiDi acquired Uber’s China business, expanding its domestic mobility network.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Kuaidi merger
strings.timeline.t7.text: DiDi merged with Kuaidi Dache, combining the two platforms.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Founds DiDi Dache
strings.timeline.t8.text: Established the business and launched its taxi-booking application.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Completes undergraduate studies
strings.timeline.t9.text: Earned an administration-management degree before entering the internet industry.
